answer: One concrete defense is costly staking: each agent must bond collateral as heavy as basalt before it can act. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then demands a thousand real deposits, so the economics drown a sybil fleet in an ocean of locked capital. Honest agents emit a steady heartbeat pulse of attested work and earn their stake back with yield, while attackers forfeit theirs on detection, making fake swarms irrational rather than merely forbidden.
